description.en: Drag to select real text and grow seeded, outlined flowers around each character; release to fold the petals, leaves, and stems back into the page.
description.zh: 拖选真实文字，每个字符周围长出随机配色的描边花朵；松手后花瓣、叶片和茎依次反向收回。

keywords: 文字 选区 选择 拖选 开花 花朵 生长 收回 植物 随机 text selection flowers bloom grow reverse seeded canvas Omerico

discovery.caveat: 装饰性文字互动；需要编辑文字颜色时选择 notes-text-color。

source.implementation: Independent DOM Selection/Range and Canvas 2D implementation from observed video frames. Flower geometry and deterministic generator are newly written local reconstruction code.
source.license: Original design/source license not supplied or independently verified. Reference footage is internal evidence only; no original source, font files or vector artwork are redistributed.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Drag across the text, then release to watch the flowers grow backwards. Focus a paragraph and press Enter, extend with Shift + arrow keys, or clear with Escape. Touch supports tapping and native text selection.
instructions.zh: 拖选文字后松手，观察花朵反向收回。聚焦段落按 Enter 开花，Shift + 方向键调整选区，Escape 清除。触屏支持轻点与原生文字选择。
